pedagogical_depth.justification: Every lesson includes a full expanded_walkthrough naming a Grade-1 trap (attribute drift, perspective trap, wrong fold, over-overuse, vague directions), with teacher_script, common_misconceptions, and recovery_moves. Summative rubric covers all 5 expectations on Ontario's 4-level scale.

instructional_balance.justification: Each lesson follows the Ontario minds_on / action / consolidation arc (12 + 25 + 13 = 50 min). Action structure 'whole_group_then_centres' (and 'individual' for capstone). Three rotating stations of 7 min each. Differentiation tiers explicit per lesson.

clarity_communication.justification: Voice is consistent: Tig and Coco anchor every minds-on; vocabulary introduced/reinforced is named explicitly; success_criteria use child-friendly 'I can' phrasing.

alignment.justification: Curriculum codes (E1.1-E1.5) mapped lesson-by-lesson. Summative rubric covers all 5 with descriptors matching blueprint text exactly. Image-text alignment validation passes.

appearance.justification: Composite generation passes 0 placeholders thanks to smart_fallback + TIG and COCO entries in _CHARACTER_CLIPART. Pre-grade drift check passes with 0 issues across all categories.
